## Implementation and safeguards

Exactly four existing sources changed: repository.js, json-repository.js, contracts.d.ts and host/repository-host.js. Exactly 22 approved new outputs were added. Existing tests, fixtures, reports, command/completion/recurrence/import algorithms, domain schemas, serializers, F1/F2/N0 and production startup remain unchanged.

The private writer shares N2's actual disposable private-v4 repository, queue and owned lease. Public N2 remains read-only. Admission is enforced inside execution and final publication. Private storage/port/lease bindings and candidate-sealed permits reject retained/reconstructed handles, copied lease references, missing/forged/foreign tickets, captured permits, mutated options and alternative signatures. The empty initial authority allowance is limited to explicit creation. Standalone core behavior is preserved.

Normal receipts bind the complete stable command and admission evidence through versioned existing private coordination. Identical replay returns original effects; changed command, reason, owner/revision or evidence guards conflicts. Capabilities, epochs and lock tokens remain volatile. Older receipt shapes remain compatible.

Publication/acknowledgement uncertainty retains the original operation and blocks another intent. Changed evidence conflicts while the original remains uncertain. Actual CURRENT replacement followed by unreadability requires authoritative reconciliation and identical replay, without replacement identities or duplicate successors. Cancellation cannot roll back publication. Observed fences are checked before replay and again at final publication, including the reproduced late-observation races.
